crossRefs.note: I cling to your statutes, Yahweh. Don’t let me be disappointed.
Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed.
For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and…
Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the…
Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his…
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

translations.web: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
translations.bsb: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
translations.kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
translations.asv: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.
